propositions: Removal records for links never confirmed by peer reach the applier and incorrectly unlink local-only links that were never pushed.

The outbound ADD dedup on (vendor_type, target_key) without relation scoping allows local links with vendor-type collisions to outbound-ADD and bypass G4 protection, leaving removal records unprotected.
The applier must consult peer_confirmations before removing inbound links, declining removal of never-confirmed links with WARNING log and returning False to maintain idempotency.
Backfill-sourced confirmations must still allow removal convergence on the first post-upgrade pass rather than decline legitimate peer deletions.
A None/unopenable confirmation store must disable the check and restore pre-story removal behavior as a fail-open contract.
